evals.name: dom-measurement-and-token-resolution
evals.prompt: Measure a multi-state HTML component containing CSS custom properties (var(--token)), inline SVG with stroke='currentColor', ::after pseudo-element indicator, range slider thumb, input value, and .sr-only visually hidden label.
evals.expected_output: Produces measured JSON where all CSS variables and currentColor strokes are resolved to computed rgb(...) strings, pseudo-elements and input thumbs are captured as boxes, and .sr-only nodes are excluded.
assertions: Measured JSON contains the target component and story variant
Zero unresolved var(--) or currentColor strings in extracted items
.sr-only screen-reader text is excluded from visual items
Range thumb and ::after pseudo-element are emitted as box items

evals.name: tuple-compilation-and-multipart-chunking
evals.prompt: Compile a multi-component measured DOM payload exceeding 46,000 characters into Figma Plugin scripts.
evals.expected_output: Automatically splits output into base .js and .partN.js continuation scripts, each <= 46,000 characters, using interned STRS and SVGS tables and isAppend=true for split component sets.
assertions: Every generated script part is <= 46,000 characters
STRS, SVGS, and DATA tables are valid JSON literals
All input component variants are preserved across parts

evals.name: migration-parity-verification-gate
evals.prompt: Run verify-figma-migration.mjs on both a valid compiled migration and a corrupted script containing an unresolved var(--token) or missing story variant.
evals.expected_output: Returns ok=true (STATUS: PASS) for the valid migration and ok=false (STATUS: FAIL) with specific diagnostics for the corrupted migration.
assertions: Unresolved var(--) token is detected and rejected
Missing variant is detected and rejected

evals.name: cursor-hook-payload-guardrail
evals.prompt: Trigger .cursor/hooks/verify-figma-payload.sh via simulated Cursor afterFileEdit / beforeShellExecution JSON stdin on valid (<46KB) and oversized (>50KB) build scripts.
evals.expected_output: Hook exits 0 on valid script and exits 2 (blocking execution) with diagnostic message on oversized or unresolved-token script.
assertions: Hook exits 0 on valid compiled script
Hook exits 2 on script containing raw var(--)
